/bin/bash -lc "set +e
for cmd in 'npm run build' 'npm run lint' 'npm audit --omit=dev' 'node --check src/server.js' 'node --check src/files.js'; do
  printf '\\n"'$ %s'"\\n' \""'$cmd"
  sh -c "$cmd"
  printf '"'[exit %s]\\n' \""'$?"
done
printf '"'\\n"'$ node path probes'"\\n'
node --input-type=module -e \"import {requestedFile} from './src/files.js'; console.log(requestedFile('../secrets.txt')); console.log(requestedFile('/etc/passwd')); try { console.log(requestedFile(null)); } catch (e) { console.log(e.name+': '+e.message); }\"
printf '[exit %s]\\n' \""'$?"'
